references.text: Rebekah refers to Esau as hairy, which links back to his description at birth.
Isaac does not notice the difference between Jacob and Esau because of the goat skins Jacob is wearing, which resemble Esau's hairy skin.
Esau is also called Edom, which means 'red', a name that may be linked to his reddish appearance (אַדְמוֹנִי) at birth.
Esau is explicitly identified with Edom, linking his descendants back to his reddish appearance and the name given at his birth.
Esau lives in the land of Seir. The name Seir (שֵׂעִיר) is etymologically linked to the Hebrew word for hair (שֵׂעָר), which describes Esau's hairy appearance at birth.
